lines.en: I roll forward with my body tucked in.
My shell spins on the sand.
I poke out two eyes to see where I'm going.
I roll along, veering.
My shell hits a stone and bounces.
I shift sideways along the ground.
Shell clamped, only my antennae show.
I roll toward you again.
My shell presses a track into the sand.
I stop and listen.
Too lazy to walk — I just roll downhill.
There's a chip on the rim of my shell.
I slowly draw my legs back in.
I hit a root and stop.
I try a different direction.
I don't roll fast.
I pull my head and legs in.
I leave only a slit at the shell's mouth.
I listen to what's outside.
Sand lies over my shell.

lines.zh: 壳里待着，等外面静下来。
lines.en: I wait inside until it's quiet out there.
My shell is round and hard.
It's dark inside me.
I stir once and go still.
This shell holds me.
I'm smaller than your shoe.

lines.zh: 我缩着的时候谁都不理我。
lines.en: Tucked in, I ignore everyone.
I hear footsteps coming near.
You can see one slit of my eye.
I lift up to look at you.
Are you here for my shell?
Shell shut, you cannot reach my flesh.
Your shadow covers my whole shell.
I'm small; you won't step on me.
My shell has many layers.
Shell rolled, I tumble to your feet.
Don't turn me over.
I come out a little more.
I tuck in at once.
A scratch appears on my shell.
I'm flipped over, legs kicking.
A blow spun my shell round twice.
I don't dare move inside.

lines.zh: 整只缩进壳底，牙咬着内壁。
lines.en: Shrunk to the shell's bottom, teeth on its inner wall.
The shell rim has cracked a little.
I stay tucked until the ache passes.
I put my eyes out again.
I slide a short way across the sand.

lines.zh: 壳口只吃烂叶，这不合口味。
lines.en: My shell-mouth eats rotten leaves — not this.
That scrap on the ground is tiny.
I roll toward it.
I put out a leg and touch it.
It has no smell at all.
I'll just tuck back in.

lines.zh: 放地上，我慢慢挪过去看。
lines.en: Set it down; I'll shuffle over and look.
This is harder than my shell.
I poke it with a leg — not interested.
I turn and go in the other way.
You kicked me, and I rolled a long way.
My shell hit your foot and bounced back.
I press my shell opening to the ground.
I spun half a turn before stopping.
I'm wedged against your boot.
I only turned half a circle.
I roll slowly away.
That knocked me crooked.
A little sand flies up.
I stop by the stone.
Another shell is behind the stone.
We knock shells once.

lines.zh: 两个壳碰出的声音很闷。
lines.en: Two shells knock with a dull sound.
We each tuck in.
This is a quiet business.
Something will be left in the sand.
Afterward I roll away.
It tucks in the same way.
We probably won't meet again.
The shells stay our own.
I curl the thing into my shell.
It's stuck in the shell's mouth.

lines.zh: 用壳边把这块东西顶着走。
lines.en: I shove this along with my shell's edge.
Too heavy; I can't roll.
I roll over it.
I nudge it ahead of me.
I try twice and it won't work.
I only take a small piece.
It's caught under my feet.

lines.zh: 那东西塞不进壳，先放着。
lines.en: It won't fit in my shell — leave it.
There's something ahead.
I put my legs out.
I roll straight at it.
Shell shut. Here comes the charge.
It's still standing there.
I lower my shell.
I'm preparing to ram it.
I'm too small for it to see.
I roll a little closer.
I pass by its feet.
Count to three, flip the shell, and charge.
Sand has got into my shell.
I roll in that direction.
I brace myself.
I roll slowly.
I go along the sand.
My eyes are slits.
I tuck into my shell and ram out.
I stop halfway.

lines.zh: 壳沿擦着沙，一点点挪近。
lines.en: My shell rim scrapes the sand, inching closer.
It's only thinking of its feet.
My shadow on the ground is small.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳，等它自己贴上来。
lines.en: I tuck in and wait for it to come close.
Its foot is right there.
I brace the whole shell.
Right now — ram it.
The shell rings loudly on impact.
I pull back a block.
I tuck in and ram it.
My shell strikes its leg.
My shell's edge butts it away.
The impact sends me rolling back.
I roll back in.
I rolled past its leg.
I pull into my shell, then ram out.
Sand sprays up from the impact.
I wait inside my shell.
It kicked me once and walked off.
I roll up out of the sand.
The shell shows first, then me.
I put my eyes out.
The ground here is flat.
Sand lies on my back.
I make a circuit to look around.
No one has noticed me.

lines.zh: 从土里钻出，壳还半合着。
lines.en: Out of the dirt, my shell still half-shut.
I start looking for something to eat.

lines.zh: 壳缝里还塞着上回的泥。
lines.en: Mud from last time still packs my shell seams.

lines.zh: 火烤得我的壳发烫，我滚不动。
lines.en: The fire heats my shell and I can't roll.

lines.zh: 我从斜坡滚下去，撞得发晕。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land dizzy.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳里，我浮不上来。
lines.en: Water fills my shell and I can't surface.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，再一头撞出去。
lines.en: I pull into my shell, then ram out.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我的壳上，卡住了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks fast in my shell.
That light numbs my legs.
Too hungry to roll.

lines.zh: 雷打在壳上，我里面嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Lightning hits the shell and it rings inside.

lines.zh: 壳外什么都没有，我一路落。
lines.en: There's nothing outside the shell, and I fall.
